# CDB Endpoints

Server endpoints whose `url.path` contains one of the tracked patterns. Adjust the time window via the dashboard timeframe selector.

2.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:500
| filter contains(lower(url.path), lower("/banking/services/"))
| filter span.kind == "server"
| summarize distinctEndpoints = countDistinctExact(url.path)
2.title: Distinct Endpoints

3.title: Endpoints matching /banking/services/

5.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:500
| filter contains(lower(url.path), lower("/cdb/"))
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = url.path
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/prd-' LD:stage '/api/'", "/api/")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/session-data/' LD:key EOS", "/session-data/{cacheKey}")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'v' INT:ver '/' LD:id '/'", "v{ver}/{id}/")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'v' INT:ver '/' LD:id EOS", "v{ver}/{id}")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/statementSummary/' LD:id EOS", "/statementSummary/{id}")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/statementTransactions/' LD:id EOS", "/statementTransactions/{id}")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/' INT:n '/'", "/{id}/")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/' INT:n EOS", "/{id}")
| summarize distinctEndpoints = countDistinctExact(normalizedPath)
5.title: Distinct Endpoints

6.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:500
| filter contains(lower(url.path), lower("/cdb/"))
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = url.path

// Strip API Gateway stage prefix
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/prd-' LD:stage '/api/'", "/api/")

// Cache keys
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/session-data/' LD:key EOS", "/session-data/{cacheKey}")

// IDs following any segment ending in v<N> — catches /v1/, /api-v3/, /servicenamev2/, etc.
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'v' INT:ver '/' LD:id '/'", "v{ver}/{id}/")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'v' INT:ver '/' LD:id EOS", "v{ver}/{id}")

// Specific known endpoints with trailing IDs
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/statementSummary/' LD:id EOS", "/statementSummary/{id}")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/statementTransactions/' LD:id EOS", "/statementTransactions/{id}")

// Fallback: any remaining purely-numeric segment
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/' INT:n '/'", "/{id}/")
| fieldsAdd normalizedPath = replacePattern(normalizedPath, "'/' INT:n EOS", "/{id}")

// Sort before summarize so lastSeen and latestTraceId come from the SAME span.
| sort start_time desc
| summarize {
    trafficCount = count(),
    distinctRawPaths = countDistinctExact(url.path),
    lastSeen = takeFirst(start_time),
    latestTraceId = takeFirst(trace.id)
  },
  by: { normalizedPath }

| fieldsAdd analyzerLink = concat(
    "https://cdbdashboard-route-cdb-auto-63623-dv1.ingress.water.ocp4-dv.bmogc.net/error-analyzer",
    "?trace_id=", latestTraceId,
    "&env=PROD",
    "&from=", formatTimestamp(lastSeen - 2m, format:"yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'", timezone:"UTC"),
    "&to=", formatTimestamp(lastSeen + 2m, format:"yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'", timezone:"UTC")
  )

| sort trafficCount desc
| limit 500
6.title: Endpoints matching /api/cdb/
